Eva hopes to visit Paris one day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the bus stop by bike. The weather was snowy that day. The bridge crosses the wide river.
Eva wrote about the day in the diary. Eva usually has chicken for breakfast. Life is full of small surprises. For example, the hotel room has a sea view.
Eva is going to travel to Paris in August. Eva wants to be a teacher in the future. The bus stop is one of the best places in the city. Which season do you like best?
Eva thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. There are always many people at the ticket office. Eva learned a lot about English.
